This is a '''list of countries by exports per capita''': the value of a country's exports of goods and services in 1765 divided by its population. Export figures are from the [[Global Trade Union]]<ref name="gtu">{{Cite web |url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/trade-outlook/1765/countries |title=International trade statistics by country, 1765 |website=globaltradeunion.org |publisher=[[Global Trade Union]] |date=1765}} Retrieved 1765.</ref> and population estimates from the [[World Data Union]].<ref name="wdu">{{Cite web |url=https://www.worlddataunion.org/population/1765 |title=World population estimates, 1765 |publisher=[[World Data Union]] |date=1765}} Retrieved 1765.</ref> Values are in {{lahn}} at current prices. Merchandise exports include re-exports, which is why several small trading states with large ports rank near the top.
